title: ue5-iostore-appearance-porting
summary: Analyze, build, verify, and troubleshoot UE5 IoStore cosmetic appearance-transfer mods, especially NTE character or vehicle meshes, paid-owned skin visuals, combat and vehicle VFX, ultimate sequences, UI previews, NPC appearances, dye compatibility, and condition-gated effects. Use when redirecting one owned appearance onto another local cosmetic path, making cosmetic effects global, diagnosing full-awaken skin glow (满命皮肤发光), missing materials/animations/VFX or IoStore crashes, or packaging .pak/.ucas/.utoc mods without changing entitlement logic.
